Operating Revenue
Revenue from Sales Revenue from Rental and Services Operating Revenue
1Q/2026
▪Operating revenue decreased -1.5% YoY and -6.7% QoQ.
▪Revenue from Sales declined both YoY (-3.1%) and QoQ (-7.9%), primarily due to weaker consumer spending, inflationary pressure from conflicts in the Middle East that 
push higher oil prices and product costs, lower tourist arrivals, and softer project sales. On a year -on-year basis, sales were additionally affected by the absence of 
government stimulus measures (Easy E -Receipt).
▪The %GMP from sales improved YoY and QoQ, from effective discount management across both retail stores and online channels, i ncluding from the lower proportion of 
project sales. 
▪Rental and services revenue increased both + 17.6% YoY and + 6.6% QoQ, driven by the opening of new branches, Little Walk Ramkhamhaeng in late Q 3/2025 and Little 
Walk Phran Nok–Phutthamonthon in March 2026 .
▪The %GMP from rental improved YoY due to the average occupancy rate improved. However, on a quarter -on-quarter basis, %GPM decli ned due to an accounting 
reclassification recorded in the prior period, which resulted in unusually low rental and service costs. Excluding the impact ofthis accounting adjustment, gross profit margin 
would have continued to improve approx. + 1.0%.

Selling & Administrative Expenses
Quarterly Period 
1Q/2026
▪The selling and administrative expenses increased + 2.8% YoY, due to new branch expansions and higher online 
platform fees in line with the growth of online sales. While the ratio of selling and administrative expenses to 
operating revenue rose following weaker overall sales.
▪The selling and administrative expenses decreased -8.9% QoQ, primarily due to flood -related provisions and 
accounting adjustments recorded in the previous quarter (depreciation items). Excluding these items, the decrease in 
SG&A expenses in 1Q/2026 would have been decreased -4.1%, while the SG&A -to-operating revenue ratio would
